summary: Learn to monitor LLMs, manage releases, and improve safety with practical LLMOps methods. Build dashboards, scorecards, and action plans.
lede: LLMOps and AI Model Monitoring helps teams deploy, observe, govern, and improve large language model applications after release. The course covers prompt and model versioning, quality and latency measurement, drift detection, safety evaluation, token-usage observability, and disciplined release rollback. You will turn operational signals into monitoring definitions, evaluation rubrics, alert-to-incident workflows, and release go/no-go checklists. Practical exercises with dashboards, scorecards, and versioning workflows also introduce retrieval-augmented generation governance, traffic routing, security guardrails, and deployment orchestration concepts for model-release CI/CD.
audienceIntro: This LLMOps and AI Model Monitoring training is designed for professionals who already work near production AI systems and need to make them dependable, observable, and governable.
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of Python, basic machine learning concepts, and familiarity with generative AI concepts such as prompts, embeddings, and retrieval-augmented generation. Prior exposure to cloud notebooks, Git-based workflows, and simple dashboards will help you move faster, but coding/programming is required only at a practical operational level, not at production engineering depth. Advanced topics are taught at the operational application level, with selective hands-on exercises in monitoring design, metric interpretation, and release controls.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
